content: CSS filter saturate() works on HTMLVideoElement in both WebKit (Safari 6+, hardware-accelerated, applies directly to video) and Chromium without flags. Filters are GPU-composited over decoded video frames; cost scales with video resolution. Static filters are cheap; animating heavy blurs causes repaint jank on mobile. Apply via element style.filter; cross-origin video without CORS can interfere with some filter combos but Reels are same-origin. Use filter on the video element itself or its non-obfuscated wrapper.
